data.long_meaning: Aleandra is derived from the Latin word 'alere' which means 'to nourish' and the Old Greek word 'andros' which means 'man' or 'male'. The name Aleandra is believed to represent an exalted or noble woman, possibly one who has devoted her life to nurturing and caring for others. The name Aleandra carries the meaning “Exalted or noble woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Aleandra usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted or noble woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aleandra total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
